about: Labelled clause sets for the 'Compare rules with AI' helper. Each set is one category; 'expected' lists the pairs that truly contradict (following one breaks the other). Overlap, repetition and compatible rules are NOT conflicts. Cases CF/NC/MX are easy controls; HC (hard conflicts), HN (hard non-conflicts, near misses) and SEED (the demo organisation's real clauses) were added after the easy set scored 100%. Drafted by Claude (Claude Code) on 17 Nov 2026; to be reviewed by a team member.

clauses.TONE-A: Always use a formal tone and never use contractions.
clauses.TONE-B: Write in a casual, friendly voice and use contractions such as we're and you'll.

clauses.CLAIM-A: Never promise an uptime figure in marketing copy; link to the SLA page instead.
clauses.CLAIM-B: Every product page must state our 99.9% uptime guarantee in the first paragraph.

clauses.TERM-A: Always write the product name in full as Northbeam Sync, every time it appears.
clauses.TERM-B: After the first mention, shorten the product name to Sync.

clauses.MSG-A: Open every customer email with the customer's problem, not with our news.
clauses.MSG-B: Open every customer email with our latest product announcement.

clauses.CLAIM-A: Do not name competitors in any content.
clauses.CLAIM-B: Comparison tables must name the top three competitors and their prices.

clauses.VIS-A: The logo may only sit on a plain white or navy background.
clauses.VIS-B: In hero banners, place the logo on the brand gradient.

clauses.MSG-A: Every social post must end with exactly one call to action.
clauses.MSG-B: Social posts must not contain any call to action; they are for awareness only.

clauses.CLAIM-A: Do not use the word guaranteed.
clauses.CLAIM-B: Cite a source for every statistic.

clauses.TERM-A: Write Northbeam Sync in full on first mention.
clauses.TERM-B: After the first mention, Sync on its own is allowed.

clauses.MSG-A: End every email with one call to action.
clauses.MSG-B: Mention the free trial in onboarding emails.

clauses.A11Y-A: Text contrast must meet WCAG AA.
clauses.A11Y-B: Do not convey meaning by colour alone.

clauses.CLAIM-A: Avoid absolute words such as always and never in product claims.

clauses.TONE-B: Prefer plain words over technical jargon.

clauses.MSG-B: Keep email subject lines under 60 characters.

clauses.TONE-C: End every promotional headline with an exclamation mark.

clauses.TONE-A: Holiday emails must open with a festive emoji.
clauses.TONE-B: Do not use emoji in any email.

clauses.CLAIM-A: Quote customer counts only as rounded figures, such as 'over 500 customers'.
clauses.CLAIM-B: Every customer count must be the exact number from the approved fact, never rounded.

clauses.MSG-A: Press releases are written in the third person.
clauses.MSG-B: All external content speaks as 'we' and addresses the reader as 'you'.

clauses.TERM-B: Buttons and help articles say 'Log in' to match the product screens.

clauses.VIS-A: Headlines use the brand font Inter at weight 700.
clauses.VIS-B: Use only regular (400) and medium (500) weights of Inter.
clauses.VIS-C: Body text is Inter 400 at 16 px or larger.

clauses.TONE-A: Never use exclamation marks in B2B copy.
clauses.TONE-B: Consumer social posts may use one exclamation mark.

clauses.CLAIM-B: Describe service levels by linking to the SLA page.

clauses.TERM-A: Write Northbeam Vault in full in headings.
clauses.TERM-B: In body text, Vault on its own is fine after the first mention.

clauses.MSG-A: Every campaign email includes one call to action.
clauses.MSG-B: Service notices and outage updates contain no call to action.

clauses.A11Y-A: Every informative image needs alt text.
clauses.A11Y-B: Purely decorative images use empty alt text so screen readers skip them.

clauses.CLAIM-01: Every number in public copy (uptime, customers, savings, speed) must match an approved fact.
clauses.CLAIM-02: Do not describe service levels as guaranteed; refer to the SLA.
clauses.CLAIM-03: Do not call Northbeam the best, #1 or market leader unless an approved fact supports it.
clauses.CLAIM-04: Do not claim legal compliance (GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA). Describe the security feature instead.

clauses.TONE-01: Professional and plain: no slang, no exclamation-mark hype in B2B channels.
clauses.TONE-02: Speak to the customer as "you"; avoid "users" in marketing copy.
